name: komdosh-claude-developer
description: Backend dev plugin for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux/coroutines services. Ships 23 specialised agents, 17 slash commands, 9 mandatory skills, 12 rule documents, and 2 post-edit hooks — enforcing hexagonal architecture, coroutine safety, RFC 9457 error semantics, vendor-decoupled platform abstractions, and end-to-end QA artifact generation.
author: Andrey Tabakov
